display.title: Episode 7: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Another pot-cover march, a young listener leads the Shema, and chapter 1 of "The Ten Wedding Gifts": an orphan couple spends their wedding money to free a chained old man.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi thanks parents for letters describing how families hush for the show every Tuesday at six, and reminds listeners that its goal is achdus. Everyone, studio staff included, marches again with spoon-and-pot-cover drums. A girl who wrote in last week, having learned the Shema from the program, comes to the studio and leads the Shema word by word. Story time begins "The Ten Wedding Gifts". Reuven, a kind innkeeper, raises two orphans, Avraham and Sarah, as his helpers; when they grow up he suggests they marry, and gives them a purse of 600 gold coins to buy their wedding clothes at the fair. On the way they meet an old man in chains, led away by a cruel officer and begging for help. The officer's price is exactly 600 gold coins, and with Sarah's nod Avraham pays it and frees the man. Penniless, they head home to Reuven, and what happens next waits for chapter 2. The mailbox has letters about the theme song "We Want Moshiach Now" and the story "The Two Voices".
display.lesson: Kindness and freeing captives are worth more than anything we own.
